Type: geometric wool runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or bedside floor; entryway, hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: modern, mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: wool, low tufted pile
Colors: warm taupe brown, cream lines
Shape: long narrow rectangle, thin cream slanted lines forming elongated hexagon links, flat low pile, slim and light
Feel: subtle, warm, refined
Goes with: light wood floors, grey upholstery, mustard accents; modern or mid-century rooms

product.description: 45% Viscose, 40% Wool, 15% Cotton Imported With its contrasting shades and modern geometric design, this versatile rug is ideal for contemporary, medium-traffic rooms. Hand-tufted in India with a wool and viscose blend, it wears well with time. Runner rug features a neutral-toned geometric pattern Hand-tufted with a wool/viscose blend Plush .6'' pile suits medium-traffic, indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 2'6 x 8' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle
